decision_summary: QIF v0.6.15 Release Ready Hook is release-ready.
rationale: The change is bounded to a local fail-closed reference hook, keeps semantic truth boundaries explicit, and passed normal hook, fail-closed hook, validate-all, and npm test verification.
recommendation: Release v0.6.15 and keep CI adapters, external hooks, semantic approval, and remediation planning for later slices.
expected_user_reaction: Users can wire a local command into release workflows so release-ready status depends on a valid quality gate package.
